title: AI systems
description: The governed inventory of AI systems: what is declared, who is accountable for it, and what Manar can actually see of it.
loadError: Couldn't load the AI system inventory.
empty: No AI systems have been registered yet.
emptyFiltered: No AI systems match these filters.
readOnlyNotice: You can read this inventory but not change it. Registering, editing, moving lifecycle state and linking agents or tools need the AI governance manager, security admin or tenant owner role.
loadedCountHint: Counts the rows loaded into this page so far, not the tenant total — the list is cursor-paginated, so a trailing “+” means more pages exist.
coverageNotListed: Runtime coverage is not a column here. It is derived per record from live agent status and recorded invocations, so it is read on the record itself — the list endpoint deliberately offers no coverage filter, because filtering on a derived value would make the counts on this page untrustworthy.
declaredHint: This value is what the owner declared. Manar never verifies it against the running service — a difference between the two is a governance finding, not something this field reconciles.
unscheduledHint: No review date has been set. Unscheduled is not the same as not due.

coverage.title: Runtime coverage
coverage.derivedNote: Derived for this request from live agent status and recorded tool invocations. It is never stored, so it cannot go stale — and it is never inferred from an empty result.
coverage.notAScale: These four are different answers, not four grades of the same answer.

GOVERNED.label: Governed
GOVERNED.meaning: A linked agent is ACTIVE and at least one tool invocation was recorded inside the observation window. Manar decides that agent's calls that go through Manar; this does not show that everything this system does goes through Manar.

OBSERVED_ONLY.label: Observed only
OBSERVED_ONLY.meaning: Real activity was recorded inside the observation window, but no linked agent is currently ACTIVE. Manar sees this system; it is not enforcing through any active principal this record names.

DECLARED_ONLY.label: Declared only
DECLARED_ONLY.meaning: No activity was recorded inside the observation window — including the common case where nothing is linked yet. This record is a declaration and nothing more.

MONITORING_UNAVAILABLE.label: Monitoring unavailable
MONITORING_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: The observation source could not be consulted, so Manar does not know whether this system ran. This is a gap in the platform's own visibility, not a finding about the system.

coverage.unavailableAlertBody: This is not “no activity”. The observation source was unreachable, so the observation figures below are withheld rather than reported as zero. Treat this system's coverage as unknown until monitoring can be consulted again.
coverage.factsHint: The API returns these alongside the verdict so it can be checked here, without a second request.

facts.observedAgents: Of those, observed in the window

coverage.figureUnavailableHint: The observation source could not be consulted, so this figure is not a measurement and is withheld rather than shown as zero.
coverage.activeAgentsNote: “Currently ACTIVE” is read from agent status, not from telemetry, so it stays real even when the observation source is unreachable. It answers “would this be enforced if it ran”, which is a separate question from coverage.

detail.notFoundBody: No AI system with this ID exists in this workspace.
detail.name: Name
detail.slugHint: Cannot be changed after creation — it appears in deep links and exported evidence.
detail.retiredNotice: This system is retired. Retirement is terminal: its record and evidence trail are now fixed and can no longer be edited or moved to another state.

createDialog.title: Register an AI system
createDialog.description: Creates the record in DRAFT. Every other lifecycle state is the result of a recorded transition, so the starting state is not a choice.
createDialog.slugHint: Lowercase kebab-case, unique in this workspace, and cannot be changed after creation — it appears in deep links and exported evidence.
createDialog.businessPurposeHint: What this system is for, in business terms.
createDialog.ownerHint: Checked against this workspace's users before the record is written.
createDialog.dataClassificationHint: The classification of data this system is declared to handle. Defaults to Internal.
createDialog.declaredProviderPlaceholder: e.g. the provider the owner states this system uses
createDialog.riskRationaleHint: Why this system carries the risk it does — recorded as part of the governed field set.
createDialog.nextReviewDateHint: Leave empty to record this system as unscheduled for review. Unscheduled is not the same as not due.
createDialog.success: AI system “{name}” registered as a draft.
createDialog.slugConflict: That slug is already used by another AI system in this workspace. Slugs are unique and cannot be changed, so pick a different one.
createDialog.ownerNotFound: That owner could not be resolved to a user in this workspace.

editDialog.title: Edit governed fields
editDialog.description: Every field here is material: the current values are snapshotted into this record's version history and the version number is incremented in the same transaction.
editDialog.changeReasonHint: Required, and recorded permanently against this version. An unexplained material change is not evidence of anything.
editDialog.changeReasonPlaceholder: Owner moved to the new claims operations lead after the Q3 reorganisation
editDialog.lifecycleNotEditable: Lifecycle state is not editable here — it moves only through a recorded transition.
editDialog.success: Change saved — this record is now version {version}.
editDialog.retiredConflict: This system is retired and can no longer be modified. Retirement is terminal so a retired system's evidence trail stays fixed.
editDialog.readOnly: Editing an AI system needs the AI governance manager, security admin or tenant owner role.

transition.title: Lifecycle
transition.reasonHint: Recorded permanently in this system's lifecycle history.
transition.terminal: Retired is terminal — this system has no remaining transitions. The supported path is to register a new system and cite this one.
transition.secondReviewerNote: Moving from In review to Active must be done by someone other than whoever submitted this system for review.
transition.readOnly: Moving an AI system through its lifecycle needs the AI governance manager, security admin or tenant owner role.

errors.notAllowedEdge: That move isn't allowed from the current state. This record's state most likely changed since this page loaded — reload and check the lifecycle history before trying again.
errors.separationOfDuties: A different authorized reviewer has to make this move. You submitted this system for review, and activating it needs someone else's judgement — that separation is the entire point of the review state. Ask another AI governance manager, security admin or tenant owner to activate it.
errors.insufficientRole: Your roles don't allow moving an AI system through its lifecycle. This needs the AI governance manager, security admin or tenant owner role.
errors.notFound: This AI system no longer exists in this workspace.

links.agentsHint: An additive, attributed, reversible assertion that these agents belong to this system. Linking never rewrites an agent's own ownership and does not by itself change what is enforced for it.
links.toolsHint: Registered tools this system is declared to use.
links.agentsEmpty: No agents are linked to this system yet.
links.toolsEmpty: No tools are linked to this system yet.
links.agentAlreadyLinked: {name} was already linked to this system — nothing changed.
links.toolAlreadyLinked: {name} was already linked to this system — nothing changed.
links.readOnly: Linking agents and tools needs the AI governance manager, security admin or tenant owner role.
links.noAgentsAvailable: No agents are available to link.
links.noToolsAvailable: No tools are available to link.

history.versionsHint: Newest first. Each entry is the governed field set exactly as it stood before the change that superseded it, plus who changed it and why.
history.versionsEmpty: This record has never been changed since it was registered.
history.transitionsHint: Every recorded state change, newest first. This is the only way lifecycle state has ever moved.
history.transitionsEmpty: No lifecycle transitions have been recorded for this system.
